messages.subject: Calling winbugs on a shiny app on shinyapps.io?
parts: Is it possible to call winbugs (via the package R2WinBUGS) on apps hosted on shinyapps.io? Has anyone done this before that has any tips? I am unsure how this would work since you need to have winbugs installed on the machine (so I guess in this case, the server). Thanks!

messages.subject: Re: [shinyapps-users] Calling winbugs on a shiny app on shinyapps.io?

Hi Alex,
shinyapps.io runs everything on Linux so unfortunately you can't call out to external windows binaries.

Best,
Tareef
